selection_reason: Selected for the final classification pipeline because it achieved the highest test accuracy and highest macro F1 score among the four final classification models while maintaining practical GPU inference speed.

comparison_notes.VGG16: Fastest measured batch-size-1 GPU inference, but lower classification accuracy and largest model.
comparison_notes.MobileNetV2: Smallest model, but lowest test accuracy.
comparison_notes.EfficientNetB0: Compact model with strong accuracy, but slower measured batch-size-1 GPU inference.
comparison_notes.ResNet50: Highest test accuracy and macro F1 with practical inference performance.
